labels.text: Nuclear power in Germany ends after 50 years, with the closure of the final power plants.
UEFA Euro 2024 is held in Germany, and is won by Spain.
In Solingen, Germany, a Syrian immigrant stabs three people to death, which leads to the intensification of the debate on migration in Germany.
German Chancellor Olaf Scholz dismisses FDP leader Christian Lindner from his position as finance minister, leading to two other FDP ministers resigning and the collapse of the governing coalition.
Six people are killed, while over 300 are injured, after a car is driven into a crowd at a Christmas market in Magdeburg, Germany.

2025 German federal election: After being pushed forward as a result of the 2024 German government crisis, the centre-right CDU/CSU becomes the largest party, with big gains from the far-right AfD, resulting in a second-place finish.

2025 German federal election: Friedrich Merz is elected Chancellor of Germany in the second round of parliamentary voting, hours after being defeated in the first round, a first in post-WWII German history.
The 2025 World Women's Handball Championship is held in Germany and the Netherlands, and is won by Norway.
German engineer Michaela Benthaus becomes the first wheelchair user to travel into space, aboard the Blue Origin NS-37.
The 62nd Munich Security Conference is held.
The 2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup is held in Berlin, Germany, and is won by the United States.
